name: prone single arm trap raise
description: A raise lying face down on a bench or floor with one arm. It targets the lower and middle traps and shoulder blade control.
instructions: Lie face down with one arm hanging or reaching overhead, thumb up.
Keep your forehead down and neck relaxed.
Lift your arm in a Y shape by squeezing your shoulder blade down and back.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch arms.
